# Carousel Usage Checklist

- Render items with `.carousel-item` class.
- Wrap list with `renderCarouselContainer(prefix, itemsHTML, options)`.
- Ensure `prefix` matches block-specific class naming conventions.
- Keep the shared DOM hooks generated by `renderCarouselContainer` (`.carousel-block-container`, `.carousel-list`, controls, and scrollbar thumb).
- Move UE instrumentation from authored rows to rendered list items.
- Initialize carousel with `requestAnimationFrame`.
- Use default thresholds unless requirements specify custom breakpoints.
- Use custom `carouselItemSpans` with custom thresholds when blocks use narrow tiles/cards.
- Use `equalizeHeights: true` for card-like layouts requiring aligned card heights.
- Keep `isStacked` behavior explicit when authoring can force grid mode.
- Guard re-decoration paths and avoid duplicate initialization loops.
- Keep item count passed to `initializeCarousel` explicit and accurate.
